ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity black surface (~85%) with localized high-intensity white regions (~15%) at the distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central and proximal regions are solid black. Distal tips feature white contiguous patches with high-frequency black mottling at the boundaries and internal speckling.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped notch with an approximate angle of 65 degrees at the central axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serrations along the trailing edge; left lobe displays higher amplitude peaks (approx. 8-12 pixels) compared to the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curvature extending from the median notch to the superior distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Concentrated cluster of high-contrast, textured brown/white pixels on the left distal tip boundary. Sparse white circular points distributed across the central dark region.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, vertically-oriented linear pixel disruptions in the lower-left ventral region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent barnacle colony on the far left tip; irregular trailing edge indentation on the right lobe tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique asymmetric mottling within the white distal patches, characterized by fine black stippling.
